aiIntroPolicy.flow: Show the game, introduce a tool through a concrete task, return to the game result; first full introduction only, later role recap.
aiIntroPolicy.versionRule: Creator-disclosed versions only; product documentation is capability evidence, not proof of project version.
aiIntroPolicy.capture: Use inspected official feature UI/demo material with rights checked, genuine1080p minimum. Direct authored workflow animation is allowed with an explanatory label.
aiIntroPolicy.honesty: Do not impersonate a creator session, invent prompts/results or present diagrams as actual generation. No automatic playback-speed performance claim.
aiIntroPolicy.layout: Black/white/warm-yellow brand tokens; one focus; labels outside protected source UI and fixed caption zone. Crop after inspection, preserve aspect ratio. Check1080p and375px.
aiIntroPolicy.audio: Narration first; official promo voice/music excluded. Only separately cleared relevant sound examples. Existing approved BGM remains; do not fabricate an AI-generated sample.
aiIntroPolicy.timing: Paragraph cues below are semantic, one-based. Measure new TTS before locking frame timings. No mandated insert duration or total runtime.
aiIntroPolicy.toolset: Blender is discussed as a source creator tool only; no change to our excluded production toolset.
